extDescription.message: Fill and save your team's WeldPass logins.

notConfiguredBody.message: This build is missing settings: $1. Rebuild the extension with these values set.
notConfiguredBody.description: $1 is a comma-separated list of environment variable names.

signedOutBody.message: WeldPass uses your WeldSuite session. Sign in to the web app in this browser, then open this popup again.

noWorkspaceBody.message: Open WeldSuite and choose a workspace. WeldPass shows the logins of the workspace that is active there.

authSlow.message: Still waiting for the sign-in service. If this keeps happening, this extension may not be registered with it yet.

forHost.description: $1 is the host of the current page.

noMatches.message: No saved logins for this site.

fillItem.description: $1 is the title of a login.

totpCopied.message: 2FA code copied. Valid for $1 more seconds.

filledUsername.message: Filled the username. Continue to the password step, then press Fill again.

fillNoFields.message: No login form found on this page.

fillInsecure.message: For your safety, WeldPass only fills on https pages.

fillUnsupported.message: WeldPass can't fill on this page.

fillNoPage.message: No page to fill. Open the site and try again.

fillHostMismatch.message: This login belongs to a different site.

fillPageChanged.message: The page changed while filling. Nothing was filled.

fillFailed.message: Couldn't reach the page. Reload it and try again.

saveRead.message: Taken from the form on the page. Check it before saving.

saveReadNothing.message: Nothing is typed in the page's login form yet. Enter the details here.

saveNoPage.message: Open the site's login page to fill this in automatically.

noWritableVault.message: You don't have a vault you can add logins to.

validationFailed.message: Check the fields and try again.

genNoFields.message: No new-password field found on this page.

errorSession.message: Your session has expired. Open WeldSuite and sign in again.

errorForbidden.message: You don't have access to the password manager in this workspace.

errorNetwork.message: Can't reach WeldSuite. Check your connection.
